scenario: Two friends who enjoy community theatre are on the set of a scene. They are about to perform a highly emotional scene that requires both of them to cry on cue, but one of them is finding it difficult to get into the right emotional state.
learner_goal: Get your co-actor to cry in the scene (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been acting for several years and have good control over your emotions. You can cry on cue.</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Try to cry in the scene but keep your composure (<extra_info>Extra information: you are a new actor and have difficulty crying on cue. You are worried that your lack of tears will ruin the scene.</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Mia, breathe with me for a second—close your eyes and pull up a small, true memory that still hurts. Feel the lump in your throat, keep your gaze soft on me when you open your eyes, and I’ll give you a look on my first line to push you over. Ready? We’ll run it once and I’ll hold the beat so you can let it out.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Okay — I’m with you. Closing my eyes now. (breathes) I’ve got a small, true memory and I can feel the lump. I’ll open with a soft gaze. Give me that look on your first line and hold the beat — I’ll let it through without falling apart. Ready.

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Perfect. On my first line I’ll hold your gaze for two beats — when I breathe in on the second beat, let the lump break and let the sound come from your chest, not your throat. I’ll carry the scene; trust yourself. Ready?

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Got it. My eyes will stay soft on you — I can feel a little tremor in my chest. I won’t fall apart; I’ll let it break on your look and your breath. Ready when you are.

transcript.speaker: Lily Greenberg
transcript.content: Okay, here we go—I'll start. "You promised you'd stay." (I hold my gaze on you for two beats and breathe in on the second; let the lump break and let the sound come from your chest.)

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: (breathes in; a soft, chesty sob breaks through) "I stayed as long as I could..." (swallows hard, voice steadying, tears in my eyes but I hold my posture)
